headline: Iran's IRGC warns of retaliatory strikes against US
summary: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has vowed to respond with equal force to any US attacks, citing a Quranic verse to justify its stance.
details: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has warned that any US attack on Iran will be met with a response of equal strength. This warning follows recent US military operations and Iran's subsequent retaliatory strikes against US allies in the Middle East.

headline: Tensions rise as Iran attacks Kuwaiti oil installations, causing heavy damage
summary: The strike on critical energy infrastructure has sparked regional alarms, while Pakistan warns that an attack on Saudi Arabia would be viewed as an attack on itself.
details: Iran has launched attacks on critical oil installations in Kuwait, resulting in reports of extensive damage to the facilities.
The strike on these key energy hubs has heightened tensions across the Middle East, raising concerns over the stability of global oil supplies.
Amidst the escalating conflict, a Pakistani official has issued a strong warning regarding regional security.
The official stated that any attack on Saudi Arabia would be considered an attack on Pakistan, signaling a firm defensive alliance.
These developments come at a time of extreme volatility in the region, with multiple nations on high alert for further military actions.
caption:
Iran strikes critical oil installations in Kuwait, causing heavy damage. Pakistan warns: an attack on Saudi Arabia is an attack on us.

Iran has launched attacks on critical oil installations in Kuwait, resulting in reports of extensive damage to the facilities.

The strike on these key energy hubs has heightened tensions across the Middle East, raising concerns over the stability of global oil supplies.

Amidst the escalating conflict, a Pakistani official has issued a strong warning regarding regional security.

The official stated that any attack on Saudi Arabia would be considered an attack on Pakistan, signaling a firm defensive alliance.

These developments come at a time of extreme volatility in the region, with multiple nations on high alert for further military actions.
